# Japanese Daily News Podcast

> A daily Japanese news podcast for learners. Each episode covers a real Japanese news story with vocabulary breakdowns, grammar notes, and practice quizzes. Bilingual support: English explanations + Chinese (中文) study notes. Hosted by Maya. Levels: JLPT N5–N3.

Site: https://podcast.jpnotes.dev/
Companion: https://jpnotes.dev/ (grammar notes)
Author: Ralphbupt (https://github.com/Ralphbupt)
RSS: https://podcast.jpnotes.dev/rss.xml

## Main pages

- [Home](https://podcast.jpnotes.dev/): Episode list, platform links, how it works.
- [About](https://podcast.jpnotes.dev/about/): What the podcast is, who it's for, how to use it.

## Episode structure

Each episode follows a fixed format:
1. Host intro (English) — topic overview
2. Full news reading (Japanese) — 6-7 segments at moderate speed
3. Breakdown — slow repeat of key sentences + vocabulary explanations
4. Full news replay — listen again with comprehension
5. Quiz — 3 comprehension questions
6. Vocabulary recap — key words reviewed
7. Closing

## Features

- Synced transcript with furigana (ruby annotations)
- Clickable vocabulary tooltips
- Practice mode (精听) for focused listening
- Playback speed control
- Dark mode, EN/中文 toggle, font size toggle
- Vocabulary and grammar cards per episode
